rules: Gradients belong to products only; the holdco is monochrome (near-black #0D0D0D).
Radius is scale: product = pill, holdco = medium, parent = nearly square.
Surface V1 (locked 2026-07-12): one system, not five. Page #F8F8F8, recessed panel #F6F5F4, cards #FFFFFF, dark UI/buttons/bundles #0D0D0D.
Component radius scale: chip 8, tile 14, card 20, panel 28, pill 999. Spacing (4px base): 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64.
Flat disc on product cards: hard edge, white wings at 50% of diameter. The glow treatment is retired; never build halos.
Price is per-surface judgement; ads default price-free; checkout always shows it. Primary CTA is a dark pill: Get the AI OS.
